lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted
Medicare Advantage: NCD 160.7 Electrical Nerve Stimulators
criteria_location: Position Statement only (about one page, p.2). Documentation list sits in Reimbursement Information; revision/removal rule also there.
procedures_covered: Revision or removal of SCS/DRG (reimbursement rule)

logic.top_level: pathways (trial block; permanent block = trial block AND 50% relief) with an investigational catch-all
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Inline: nociceptive and central deafferentation pain 'generally not effective'; explicit investigational list (critical limb ischemia, refractory angina, heart failure, cancer pain); psychological evaluation must show no uncontrolled mental health problem.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Permanent implant requires 50% relief in trial; revision/removal paid 'only if the implantation procedure was initially allowed and the existing stimulator, battery, or generator is malfunctioning and cannot be repaired'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Psychological evaluation was obtained and documentation clearly states the pain is not psychological in origin and/or no evidence of an uncontrolled mental health problem
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' makes the two documentation conditions either both or either

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Other treatment modalities (pharmacologic, surgical, physical, psychological) have been tried and failed OR the treatment modalities are judged to be unsuitable or contraindicated
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Unclear whether every listed modality must be tried or any one; no minimum duration

observations made six months or fewer before starting date of service

codes.non_covered_code_lists: None; investigational conditions are in text only

extraction_hazards: Criteria bullets use glyphs; sub-sentence 'AND' at ends of bullets
Permanent-implant criterion references 'all criteria for temporarily implanted stimulator' (cross-reference inside the same section)
Wide HCPCS/CPT tables; L8689 and L8695 descriptions merged across lines
Documentation requirement lives under Reimbursement, not Position Statement
interesting_structures: Trial then permanent staging with a 50% relief gate
Reimbursement rule for revision/removal tied to original authorization and malfunction

fit_to_tree.why: Short ALL-of list with one nested OR and a staging rule. Hard parts are vague leaves (last resort, failed, severe) not structure.
